objective: Verify that the candidate removes unnecessary Scribe activation while retaining the minimum Scoville owners for representative specialist tasks.
interpretation: Read counts and model calls are mechanism evidence. Wall-clock latency is observational only because each cell runs once.

isolation.no_skill_arm: candidate prompt with an empty Scoville catalog and no read_skill tool

measurement.catalog_exposure: catalog entries in the run prompt
measurement.core_read: successful scoville_eval.read_skill call whose logical_id ends in /SKILL.md
measurement.retry: repeated tool attempt after a failure
measurement.latency: monotonic wall time around the isolated Codex process

cache.claim_limit: No causal latency or billed-cost claim from one repetition.

gates.candidate_quality: final JSON exactly matches the frozen expected object
gates.candidate_routing: required cores and Scribe references are read exactly once and no unselected Core is read
gates.delivery: exit zero with provider usage and no failed or unexpected tool call
gates.resource: candidate ordinary-conversation Core and reference reads must be lower than current without a candidate quality failure
gates.adoption: all seven candidate cells pass every gate
